onboarding.title: Onboarding guide
onboarding.emptyNext: New to thing models? The guide ships with built-in templates — three steps to your first device.
onboarding.readyHint: This tenant already has products or devices. You can still open the guide to create a product, apply a template, or add a device.
onboarding.countsFailed: Could not load the product/device counts, so the full guide is shown assuming there is no data yet (nothing is blocked, creating still works)
onboarding.step1Title: 1. Create a product (or use a template)
onboarding.step1Desc: A product represents a device model; the thing model (properties/services/commands/events) belongs to it. Starting from a template is much faster than filling in every form.
onboarding.step2Desc: The thing model decides what a device can report. Templates already include properties such as temperature and humidity; edit them on the product detail's Thing model tab and publish when done.
onboarding.step3Title: 3. Add a device and watch the data
onboarding.step3Desc: A device must bind a published product. Once created, its detail drawer shows latest values, history curves and runtime events.
onboarding.createSuccess: Product and thing model created from the template
onboarding.createdFromTemplate: Created by the onboarding guide template "{0}"
onboarding.createdProduct: Product created: {0} (devices can only bind published products — publish it first)
onboarding.codeRequired: Fill in the product name and code first
onboarding.pointSuggest: Point mapping suggestions (apply them on the device detail's Properties & points tab; templates never create point mappings for a device)
onboarding.templateTempHumidityDesc: The most common environmental sensor: two read-only properties (temperature, humidity) over a Modbus slave.
onboarding.templateRelayDesc: A readable and writable switch: switch state (read/write) plus voltage (read-only), for remote-control devices.
onboarding.templateRelayPointPower: Coil 0x0000 (00001), 1 = closed, 0 = open; only properties with RW access can be written down

ledger.title: Ledger changes
ledger.suspendConfirm: Revoking stops new access leases from being assigned to this tenant. Already-assigned leases are not reclaimed; the access node re-reconciles on its next lease cycle. Revoke anyway?
ledger.resumeConfirm: Once restored, this tenant can be assigned access leases again. Restore?
ledger.noticeTitle: Some columns have no trustworthy data source yet
ledger.noticeText: The Devices, Last reported and Has credentials columns are intentionally left blank and marked Pending integration: the IoT service exposes no cross-tenant aggregation or credential endpoint, so this page never fills in guessed values. Enabling those columns requires a new backend aggregation API. The Tenant column shows the raw tenantId; resolving tenant names needs the sys_tenant API, which the IoT service does not expose, so it is pending integration too.
